scope: Proposition 3.3 (Closed paths) of the manuscript “A torsion-free hyperbolic group that is not residually finite” (preprints/a-torsion-free-hyperbolic-group-that-is-not-residually-finite-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 252 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8c67817e29f63b66), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In K, or any compatible Euclidean simplicial subdivision of it, a nonempty closed edge path whose every cyclic turn has link distance at least π is not nullhomotopic.
